description: Brainograph shared kernel (rewrite, v2): frozen platform wire contracts (response envelope, DataProvider models/executor, entity bases, permission/role enums), JWT authentication, the exception-to-envelope map, and the envelope-typed BaseApiClient.
releaseNotes: 6.36.0 — ADDITIVE: FOUR new ApplicationAdminPermission members, 240-243, ReadAiQuiz / UpdateAiQuiz / PublishAiQuiz / DeleteAiQuiz (bg-aiagent#72, the admin side of AI-generated quizzes: versions, review, approval before learners see a quiz). APPENDED AT THE END as the freeze contract requires (ordinals 1-239 unchanged; the ordinal IS the bit position in the compact perms claim); ApplicationAdminPermissionFreezeTests was taken RED first. Publish is its own grant, separate from Update. NOT a gate on generation: generation stays open to anyone with a quota, and no UseAi* member is enforced on the quiz routes (the comment that said UseAiTeachingTools gates generation was wrong and is corrected). ALSO: the four FolderLabel members 209-212 are marked [Obsolete] (a warning; bg-content#157, folder labels are removed) and keep their ordinals; a service that still names one in code gets CS0618, an error under TreatWarningsAsErrors, so it re-pins only after it stops naming them. Existing principals receive no personal grant because the enum grew — admins grant them (owner, 2026-10-05); SuperAdmin passes without one. Consumers re-pin to 6.36.0.  PREVIOUSLY, 6.35.0 — BEHAVIOUR: a request ABORTED BY THE CLIENT (HttpContext.RequestAborted cancelled, response not started) is answered 499 with no body and logged ONCE at Information (method and path, no stack) by ExceptionHandlingMiddleware, instead of 500 + Error + Sentry. An OperationCanceledException from an outbound timeout or the service's own token still maps to 500 + Error, unchanged. Amends ERROR-HANDLING section 1 (ratified 2026-07-09) on the owner's typed yes, 2026-10-05: «да, 499». No API surface changed; consumers re-pin to 6.35.0. PREVIOUSLY, 6.34.0 — ADDITIVE: SIX new ApplicationAdminPermission members, 234-239, ReadAuthoredQuiz / CreateAuthoredQuiz / UpdateAuthoredQuiz / DeleteAuthoredQuiz / RestoreAuthoredQuiz / PurgeAuthoredQuiz (bg-content#150, authored quizzes: embed codes with a title per language, shared by lessons and education folders). NOT the AI quizzes of bg-aiagent (UseAiTeachingTools). APPENDED AT THE END as the freeze contract requires: ApplicationAdminPermissionFreezeTests was taken RED first (2 of 2: the count and the name/value collection) and green only after the append; the committed catalogue is REGENERATED, not edited. Learners read Published quizzes through an [Authorize] route that needs no member. Consumers re-pin to 6.34.0; existing principals receive no personal grant from the enum growing - admins grant them (owner rule), and bg-identity adds only the role-map entries. Nothing existing changed. PREVIOUSLY, 6.33.0 — ADDITIVE: TWO new ApplicationAdminPermission members, 232 RestoreUser and 233 EraseUser (bg-identity#113, recoverable account deletion). RestoreUser reverses an administrator soft delete; EraseUser is the irreversible erasure of an already soft-deleted account. APPENDED AT THE END as the freeze contract requires: ApplicationAdminPermissionFreezeTests was taken RED first (2 of 2: the count and the name/value collection) and green only after the append; the committed catalogue is REGENERATED, not edited. Shared owns the names and ordinals; bg-identity owns the default-role distribution. Consumers re-pin to 6.33.0; existing principals receive no personal grant from the enum growing - admins grant them (owner rule). Nothing existing changed. PREVIOUSLY, 6.32.0 — ADDITIVE: TWO new ApplicationAdminPermission members, 230 RestorePresentation and 231 PurgePresentation (bg-usercontent#53). They keep reversible recovery and delete-forever separate from DeletePresentation. Owner decision 2026-09-29: ContentManager receives RestorePresentation but NOT PurgePresentation; SuperAdmin and SuperModerator receive both; no other default role receives either. APPENDED AT THE END so every existing ordinal remains unchanged. The catalogue is regenerated from the enum. Consumers must re-pin; Identity must seed the approved default-role map, while grants for already-assigned principals remain a separately measured and authorized data change. Full prior notes remain in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
